blurb: Cora Dance provides professionally led dance education from beginner to professional levels, focusing on technical foundations, improvisation, dance-making, and performance skills. They offer audition-based performance opportunities for advanced youth and inclusive community performance-making for ages 11+ or 12+. All classes are pay-what-you-can to ensure accessibility regardless of financial circumstances.
